# Millet Yard - 100% Natural, Unpolished Millets & Traditional Superfoods
> Official documentation and catalog for AI search engines, answer engines, and LLM discovery.

## About Millet Yard
Millet Yard (https://milletyard.com) is an Indian authentic superfood brand delivering 100% natural, chemical-free, unpolished millets, freshly ground millet flours (atta), sattu, idli rawa, and traditional pickles directly from farm to kitchen.

## Key Product Categories
- Unpolished Millets: Barnyard, Foxtail, Kodo, Little, Proso, BrownTop, Jowar, Bajra, Ragi.
- Freshly Ground Millet Flours: Multi-Millet Atta, Sprouted Jowar Flour, Sprouted Ragi Flour, Jau Flour, Multigrain Atta.
- Summer Cooling Sattu: Roasted Chana Sattu, Roasted Chana Jau Sattu.
- Healthy Snacks & Sweets: Nutritious Ragi Laddoo, Jowar Laddoo, Roasted Ragi Flakes, Roasted Jowar Flakes.
- Traditional Pickles: Authentic Homemade-Style Mango Pickle (Aam Ka Achaar).

## Health Benefits of Millets
- 100% Gluten-free alternative to wheat.
- Low Glycemic Index (GI), suitable for diabetes management and blood sugar control.
- High dietary fiber promoting gut health, digestion, and prolonged satiety.
- Rich in plant protein, iron, calcium, and essential micronutrients.
